svg.aria-label: RAG Research Engine: Upload your documents, ask in any language and get answers grounded only in what you uploaded. When the context doesn't hold the answer it says so instead of making one up. Retrieval favors more recent files, the context is capped at 4,000 tokens, and every answer shows the passages it came from.
